por_que: It is what you do today: the baseline to compare the other options.
With your weather, on average you lose 6.1 of every 10 seasons (grain < 70% of normal).

estrategias.descripcion: Milpa (maize + beans) in Primera and sorghum relay-planted when the maize is doubled over; half of the residue stays on the soil.

por_que: Uses the Postrera rains (from Aug 10) with sorghum: if Primera fails, there is still a harvest.
Cuts lost seasons from 6.1 to 1.0 of every 10.
evidencia: Daily FAO-56 water balance with the real weather of 25 seasons (NASA POWER 2001–2025): typical canícula from Jul 13 to Aug 2.
Monte Carlo of 1000 sequences of 10 seasons, with uncertain planting date and soil water.
Postrera onset computed year by year with the Sivakumar (1988) rule; Postrera sorghum: 22 qq/mz typical.
Relay beans or sorghum in Postrera is common practice in eastern Guatemala (MAGA; FAO Dry Corridor).
beneficios: More food: 42 qq/mz in total (range 21–54) and a second harvest to sell.
Less bare soil: 151 fewer days a year; erosion ≈ 54 t/ha/yr less.
Beans fix nitrogen and break maize pest cycles.
info_faltante: Local price of beans or sorghum and access to seed.
Whether your land holds moisture in September (very thin soils dry fast).
riesgos: Dry Postrera in El Niño years: with El Niño, sorghum is safer than beans.
More work in September, right when you double the maize.
Bean pests and diseases in heavy rain: check with the extension agent.

advertencias: Sorghum is proposed for Postrera because it tolerates drought better.

estrategias.descripcion: Milpa (maize + beans) in Primera and jack bean (canavalia) planted ~50 days later; no burning: the cover and residue protect the soil all year.

por_que: The jack bean (canavalia) covers the soil almost all year: less evaporation and more water soaking in (runoff 26 → 11 mm).
It protects the soil the most: erosion ≈ 3 t/ha/yr (vs 66 today) and organic matter -0.40 points in 5 years.
evidencia: Daily FAO-56 water balance with the real weather of 25 seasons (NASA POWER 2001–2025): typical canícula from Jul 13 to Aug 2.
Monte Carlo of 1000 sequences of 10 seasons, with uncertain planting date and soil water.
Velvet-bean green-manure systems on hillsides of Honduras and Guatemala (Buckles et al. 1998, CIMMYT/IDRC; Bunch 2003).
Mulch effect on evaporation per FAO-56 ch. 7; erosion with RUSLE (Renard et al. 1997).
beneficios: Fixes nitrogen: maize yield can rise over the years (up to +15%, approx.); typical harvest 20 qq/mz.
Bare soil: only ~11 days a year (vs 266 today).
Fewer weeds and no burning needed.
info_faltante: Where to get jack bean (canavalia) seed and how much.
How much biomass the cover reaches on your land (we estimate it with the water balance).
Whether free-roaming livestock will eat the cover in the dry season.
riesgos: Competes with maize for water if planted too early: sow it after the first weeding.
Velvet bean seed is not edible without processing (it contains L-dopa).
Soil benefits take 2–3 years to show; try it on a small plot first.

incertidumbre: Data for a ~50 km zone (not your exact plot). Ranges go from the 10% to the 90% of 10000 simulated seasons. Yield can vary ±30–50%: compare options, we do not promise quintales. In El Niño years ([2002 2004 2009 2015 2023]) today you lose 7.7 of every 10 seasons; in other years, 5.7. El Niño is active now (ONI 2.5, ASO 2026). 2040: 2001–2025 weather adjusted with monthly changes from 3 NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 models; the method does not change the number of dry days.

ia_vs_estadistica.nota: AI: logistic regression on 4 inputs known at planting (ONI AMJ, rain Apr 15–May 31 (z), root-zone wetness GWETROOT May (z), Tmax Apr–May (z)) trained on 825 seasons (33 NASA POWER zones × 2001–2025). Statistics: loss frequency by zone and El Niño state. Leave-one-year-out validation: Brier error AI 0.154 vs statistics 0.161 (lower is better) → here the AI model wins. Probability of losing next Primera if El Niño persists at planting: both are shown; the engine uses statistics.

confianza.habilidad: acertó la temporada en 14 de 25 años (56 % vs 33 % al azar) · pérdida: Brier 0.260 vs 0.236 · detectó 4 de 8 sequías documentadas · Brier IA 0.154 vs estadística 0.161
confianza.texto: Escenario 2040 (2040-ssp585): años reales 2005 con los cambios de los modelos CMIP6. No es un pronóstico. Riesgo de perder la temporada 0 %, cosecha 35–58 qq/mz. Confianza media.
confianza.texto_en: 2040 scenario (2040-ssp585): real years 2005 with CMIP6 model changes. Not a forecast. Risk of losing the season 0%, harvest 35–58 qq/mz. Confidence medium.
confianza.regla: Puntos: probabilidad del escenario ≥ 60 % → 2 (≥ 40 % → 1); validación local con ≥ 60 % de sequías documentadas detectadas → 1; temporada armada con pronóstico (o clima observado) → 1; rango de cosecha estrecho ((P90−P10)/P50 ≤ 0.5) → 1. alta ≥ 4, media 2–3, baja ≤ 1. Clima observado = alta; escenarios CMIP6 a 2040 como máximo media; nunca por encima del nivel medido en el hindcast 2001–2025 del lugar (static/validacion/habilidad.json).
